what: Hangs artwork panels (1.7×1, 8×8 cells) on a cylindrical spiral (three.js, fov 35°, 45° below 900, camera z 8). Panel i stands at position b, which is (i − rolled amount) wrapped by the panel count, at height b×.5 − .8, angle b×.85rad, radius 2, facing outward. Panels bend horizontally on a sin curve (.2), shift right by y²×.1 toward the top and bottom of the screen so the spiral arcs like a bow, and stretch sideways by rolling speed × 2. Each wheel px adds 1.5e-4 (±2 cap) to the target, which is followed .1 per frame and damped by .9 but never drops below .002, so it always turns slowly. A hovered panel (front face only) darkens by .55 and pulls forward 5%, while the back is a blurred image. At the start the panels descend from above at half radius, growing with rounded corners four at a time, staggered 50ms (per frame 1−.95^(dt×.15)). The top and bottom 20% bands of the screen fade into the edge color

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Image img to attach to the panel (multiple, hidden and read only, required)
options.repeat: How many times to repeat the image set to fill the spiral, default 2
options.vgap · angle · radius · drop: Height between panels · angle (rad) · cylinder radius · total drop, default .5 · .85 · 2 · .8
options.wheel · drift · follow · decay: Per 1px of wheel target · minimum speed · follow · damping, defaults 1.5e-4 · .002 · .1 · .9
options.fov · fov-narrow · cam: View (900 and up · below) · camera distance, default 35 · 45 · 8
options.bend · lean · sway: Panel curved depth · up-down offset · speed stretch, default .2 · .1 · 2
options.dark · zoom: Darkness of the hovered panel · pull, default .55 · .05
options.edge: Top and bottom bleed band (screen ratio), default .2 — 0 turns it off
options.stagger · delay: Stagger of every four cards on enter (ms) · time from attaching to first unfold (ms), default 50 · 200
options.start: If hidden, it waits without unfolding — send fx:show to the element to unfold it (after the loader)
options.fx:hide · fx:show: Sent to the element, the panels scatter downward (30ms stagger) or spread back out — used when switching to list view
options.fx:hover · fx:pick: Events the element emits when the hand moves over and off the plate (detail.index·el, null on release) and when the plate is pressed
options.--fx-shade · --fx-fade: Color the panel darkens to when hovered · top and bottom bleed color, default --kf-bg · --kf-line

note: three.cjs (npm CommonJS build) as a regular <script> To load it that way, include this folder’s three-global.js before it — it becomes window.THREE. The original takes the wheel wherever the mouse is on screen — this part takes only wheel events inside the element box. The original post-processing pass (top and bottom 20% to #444) is done the same way inside the plane shader. On touch drag, the original blocks horizontal dragging, but this part does not block page scrolling
